men.summary: Two games into the 2026-27 season, the Bluejays are 2-0 at home with double-digit wins over Kansas City (76-61) and Le Moyne (83-55), though both opponents were non-marquee, and Big East play and Quadrant 1 opportunities have yet to begin. With a NET of 83 and an RPI of 72, they have little postseason résumé to judge so far, so their NCAA Tournament outlook will hinge on how well they do against the tougher non-conference slate and the Big East schedule.

women.summary: Just one game into 2026-27, the Bluejays are 1-0 after a 73-71 road win at South Dakota State on Nov. 2, which counts as a Quadrant 1 victory and gives them an early résumé boost. With a NET ranking of 91 (RPI 163) and Big East play yet to begin, they'll need to build on that win in conference to climb into at-large contention, though it's far too early to project a firm postseason outlook.
